reviewedFindings.description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
reviewedFindings.rationale: This SARIF field references a deterministic Cydetix authentication operation or proof ID. src/framework-adapters/authentication.ts and src/authentication-analysis/invariants.ts generate these identifiers from stable fingerprints truncated to 16 hex characters; src/authentication-analysis/model.ts validates that public ID shape. The matched value is analysis correlation metadata, not a credential.
